info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/vidu/q4/image-to-video
info.description: Vidu Q4 Image-to-Video animates a start frame into a high-fidelity clip while preserving the subject and composition of the source image. Prompts can direct motion, camera cuts, and spoken dialogue, and native audio adds synchronized speech and sound effects. It supports durations from 3 to 16 seconds and output from 540p up to 4K.
